blocks.text: (My Reasons for Wanting to Become a Teacher)
I want to become a teacher for several reasons.
First, my school teacher sets a good example.
He loves children, and when I need help from him,
I want to be able to help others learn and grow, too.
He is excellent at teaching exactly what we need to know.
Second, my teacher knows a lot of things,
and shares his knowledge with us about many things all of the time.
I want to become a good teacher just like him.
